privacy_title: Privacy policy · Easel: Focus Timer & Art
privacy_description: Easel’s privacy policy: your focus history stays on your device; anonymous usage statistics and crash reports (PostHog EU); paintings from The Met; no ads, no tracking, no selling.
privacy_lede: Easel is meant to be a quiet place. Here is everything that happens to your data, in plain language.
privacy_updated: Last updated 17 November 2026 · Applies to Easel 1.1 and later, and this website.

privacy_summary.p: No sign-up, no advertising and no tracking across apps or websites.
Sessions, paintings and intentions are stored only on your device.
Usage events and crash reports go to PostHog’s EU cloud, never linked to you.
Artworks are downloaded from The Met’s public API. Requests contain nothing about you.
